correctness.rationale: Exact fundamental-weight cosines and Coxeter parabolic stabilizer indices yield all ridge multiplicities; disjoint face types exhaust all two-cones. Exact binomial symmetry gives the mean and asymptotic. Reproduced full orbit pairs with integer Gram products in ranks 4,5,6 and checked higher-rank closed forms.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general incidence framework is stronger on normal-fan combinatorics, but does not supply dimension-dependent Euclidean normal Gram products and their aggregate mean. The new work specializes and calculates these genuinely metric quantities.
